scope: Independent original-instruction arithmetic/buffer oracle, spying backend and pinned public SoXR wrapper integration; no Cubase execution.

independence.count_arithmetic: Exact Fraction arithmetic; separate nearest/ties-even binary64 rounding per original operation, including fused initialization and strict drift comparison.
independence.sample_model: Float32 integer-bit copying and initialized retained storage; spy generates distinguishable finite normal samples independently of candidate.
independence.public_backend: Python ctypes calls pinned public libsoxr directly with io(0,0), quality(6,0), runtime(0); separately authored instruction wrapper handles counters/storage/padding. Candidate C and application bridge are not loaded by either oracle generator.
independence.public_filter_limit: Same public backend is used on both comparison sides. This independently validates wrapper/bridge integration, not an independent SoXR filter implementation or equivalence to bundled proprietary build.

controls: Exact drift equals1 does not increment; >1 does.
Initial discard less/equal/greater than requested, partial discard contribution and singleton24x ratios.
Both input/output compaction with partial consumption and output lag; preserved trailing storage.
Copy requested rather than produced, including initialized zero storage.
Positive final repeats last frame; NULL/zero final adds zeros; final NULL drain not added to cumulative_visible.
One terminal call only; no equal-rate bypass.
Capacity/sample/domain/alias/factory/rounding preflight errors; backend failures poison state with no caller output/count publication.
Counts query without backend calls or state mutation.
Impulse, ramp, nonzero final frame and alternating signs in both44.1/48k directions plus equal rate; every returned sample bit matched via SHA256.
validation.full_suite: not run by this reviewer; root coordinates full suite and application acceptance separately

review_finding.description: Header originally implied all capacity errors leave state usable. Internal capacity/invariant failures after processing starts poison state, including failures before a later backend call.
review_finding.resolution: Header corrected to public argument/output-capacity/input-sample preflight leaves state usable; any subsequent processing error poisons state. Numerical source unchanged.

bounded_contract: Finite integral rates8000...192000, mono/stereo Float32 normal-or-zero samples, nearest-even and hardware flushing disabled.
Caller positive blocks1...65408; one final positive block or NULL/zero final; source/returned frame limits16million.
Successful fresh initialization; checked allocated storage; no retry after backend or internal processing failure.
Explicit caller partition sequence, artificial delay/discard and EOF padding preserved; no plain-soxr_process equivalence claim.
remaining_limits: No Cubase, bundled SoXR or target-host runtime samples were executed.
Public scalar SoXR build is a pinned substitute, not the bundled library or observed runtime selection.
Factory/availability and two retained native selection paths do not establish every hosted policy or fallback.
Current test cases do not certify arbitrary providers, unsupported data types, changed rates, repeated flush, oversized final blocks or whole-project playback.
Application stream scheduling, audio device delivery and GUI acceptance are outside this record.
